regime_context: The Hong Kong market is in a narrow state with only 5 of 17 thematic baskets eligible under the absolute-trend gate. Tech Hardware & Semis leads the eligible group but shows low breadth (0.167), while China Tech & Internet and Platform Megacaps are ineligible and declining. The gate is historically helpful here, so concentrating on eligible themes reduces drawdown risk.
emerging_watch: Watch for China Tech & Internet (3033.HK, scorable) to flip to 'eligible' on the absolute-trend gate and its breadth to rise above 0.6. Currently ineligible and ranking mid-table; a confirmed gate passage would suggest the downtrend has stabilized and drawdown risk has receded, potentially enabling a future overweight. Retire the watch if 3033.HK makes a new 20-day low and the gate remains failed into month-end.

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: Highest-ranked eligible theme and the current headline concentration. Eligibility under the absolute-trend gate—the only validated risk edge—suggests lower drawdown risk relative to ineligible themes. Low breadth warrants caution, but the trend persists, supporting a modest overweight.
theses.dissent: Extremely narrow breadth means a handful of stocks drive performance; any weakness in those names could reverse the trend violently, and the durable, broad-rally Conglomerates theme is a credible mean-reversion challenger.

falsifier.text: Tech Hardware & Semis underperforms the Hang Seng Index by 5% within the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: Scorable, ineligible theme deep in negative rank. The absolute-trend gate's historical edge comes from avoiding ineligible themes, so an underweight lean aligns with the drawdown-reduction discipline. The downtrend is reflected in the negative score and failed gate.
theses.dissent: Platform megacaps may rebound on policy easing or stimulus; the weak score could be mean-reverting, and a sudden headline shift could lift the ETF sharply against the current trend.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK outperforms the Hang Seng by 3% over the next 10 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
